title: Highlight of my Granada trip
text:
I was with my 2yr old baby and it was the highlight of my stay at Granada. I don’t speak French but booked to get the last minute tickets and I knew I wouldn’t be able to do as much alone with my baby. 
Antonio seemed like a very thorough guide. Even his group were a very kid-friendly one. From helping me get the ticket for my baby to checking if we were tagging along… People asked if they could translate for me or even pick up my kid to help me. Very heartwarming experience. Too many stairs so stroller isn’t a great option. 
100% recommended.

title: WITH GOOD FLAVOR IN THE MOUTH
text: They changed our guide at the last minute and in the end it was Maria Jesus, cheerful from the beginning and with a smile on her face. He gave us a guide through the Alhambra for 10, explaining everything, always willing to answer questions and even take photos of the participants. The truth is, what a pleasure, we left super happy. I hope this guide touches you. Thanks for everything . Greetings from Xixon-Asturies.
author: reichel4479

title: Great experience, very much worth it!
text: My girlfriend and I reserved this tour over the internet a few days prior. The tour very much surpassed our expectations, everything was very well organized and went smoothly. Our guide, Javi, was awesome, very knowledgeable, nice, and clearly passionate about Alhambra and its history. I very much recommend him and the tour as a whole.
